description: This file defines properties and functions related to Unicode Bidirectional (BiDi) text processing, including classes, brackets, and rune property lookups.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Provides access to BiDi properties of runes, including class, bracket status, and reverse bracket functionality.

methods.name: Class
methods.description: Returns the BiDi class for the properties instance.

methods.name: IsBracket
methods.description: Reports whether the rune is a bracket.

methods.name: IsOpeningBracket
methods.description: Reports whether the rune is an opening bracket.

methods.name: reverseBracket
methods.description: Returns the corresponding bracket rune for a given rune.

methods.name: LookupRune
methods.description: Returns properties for a given rune.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Returns properties for the first rune in a byte slice and its size.

methods.name: LookupString
methods.description: Returns properties for the first rune in a string and its size.
